pitches.note: Atopic dermatitis readout; ~0.45x cash. Still a large long-term holding in Oct 2026.
Phase 3 UC readout the next day. His biggest position ever; +1,247% by his count a year later.
HS readout he expects around mid-November 2026, then SSc data.

scorecard.bet: Pitched long at $0.676 into the atopic dermatitis readout
scorecard.note: Stock re-rated after the data; by Dec 2025 he says it was up about 400% since the pitch.

scorecard.bet: Pitched long at $9.95 the day before the Phase 3 UC readout
scorecard.note: Data positive; a year later he puts the return at 1,247%.

scorecard.bet: Long as his 2026 BioPick into the HFpEF readout
scorecard.note: Readout appears to have failed; he never said how much he held into it.

scorecard.bet: Pitched long at $4 into the HS readout
scorecard.note: He expects the HS data around mid-November 2026.

positions.statusNote: Largest position; holding long-term shares plus dip buys
positions.summary: Jan 1: calls ABVX the largest position by cost basis he has ever taken. Jun 12: bought the first dip after the safety-slide selloff. Jun 24: confirms it is his largest position and he is not selling. Jul 21: still his biggest position, holding all long-term shares from the maintenance readout plus new dip buys. Oct 22: still holding a large long-term position.

positions.statusNote: Second-biggest position; keeps adding
positions.summary: Feb 11: bought more at the open despite already being hugely overweight. May 26: says it is still his second-biggest position and he keeps buying more. Oct 22: still holding a large long-term position.

positions.statusNote: Pitched Oct 13 at $4; HS readout he expects around mid-November
positions.summary: Oct 13: third formal pitch (after NKTR and ABVX), a full thread plus research document, with bias disclaimers. Oct 23: says the stock was the only one that mattered to him that day. Oct 24-25: added an addendum to the pitch.

positions.statusNote: Bought a bunch in the mid teens
positions.summary: Sep 29: says he bought a lot of QURE in the mid teens after the stock sold off toward cash on the 4-year Huntington's data.

positions.statusNote: Bought Feb 6; still long Mar 7
positions.summary: Feb 6: shorted HIMS and bought Novo and Lilly the same day, a bet on a crackdown on compounded GLP-1s. Mar 7: says he is long Novo.

positions.statusNote: Bought Feb 6 and again Feb 14
positions.summary: Bought alongside Novo on Feb 6 and again on Feb 14 (high tide on orals plus decline of compounders).

positions.statusNote: 2026 BioPick; Aug readout looks to have failed; exit not stated
positions.summary: Jan 14: explains why he flipped bullish and made TENX his BioPick for 2026, while saying it is more likely than not to fail. Jan 22: no TENX sales so far. Aug 10: 'Tenth-X it is!', implying the binary failed; he does not say how much he held into it.

positions.statusNote: Still short; says he will cover in single digits
positions.summary: Jan 22: still short Intellia. Apr 27: calls himself a long-term NTLA bear and notes the stock is down more than 90%. Apr 29: expects single-digit prices to cover his shorts.

positions.statusNote: Got short Apr 27 after the psoriasis data
positions.summary: Apr 27: says he just got short ORKA after its psoriasis data, comparing PASI100 to Skyrizi and Bimzelx.

positions.statusNote: Shorted the +40% open on Apr 13
positions.summary: Apr 13: glad to short the 40% gap up on open-label UC data. May 19: still bearish on the valuation and timelines.

positions.statusNote: Covered the rest Mar 18; small win
positions.summary: Jan 23: short. Jan 30: covered a few thousand shares at $62-63. Feb 2: added them back at $66.60. Mar 11: his smallest position. Mar 18: closed the remainder, a single-digit % win he calls beta, not alpha.

positions.statusNote: Pitched Jul 21 at $9.95; largest position ever by cost
positions.summary: Jul 21: second formal pitch, a 25,000-word research document, the day before the Phase 3 UC readout. Jul 22: data positive; stock halted and then re-rated. Jan 1, 2026: says it was the largest position by cost basis he had ever taken.

positions.statusNote: Pitched Feb 10 at $0.676; biggest position; added repeatedly
positions.summary: Feb 10: first formal pitch at $0.676, about 0.45x cash, into the atopic dermatitis readout (also published as a guest pitch saying he is long). Mar 31 and early Apr: bought more; Apr 8: his biggest position. Jun 24-25: bought more in the $21-23 and $17 range and added to what was already his largest position. Dec 16: bought the dip after alopecia data.

positions.statusNote: 3rd largest position after the Sep Huntington's data; long Oct 27
positions.summary: Sep 29: says that on the morning of the Huntington's data he made QURE his third-largest position, behind ABVX and NKTR. Oct 27: still long.

positions.statusNote: Long and adding; 480K more shares Oct 28
positions.summary: Oct 6: 'THIS IS NOT A PITCH', but says he is long and bought more that morning. Oct 29: bought 480K more shares the day before.

positions.statusNote: 2025 BioPick (+416%); acquired, rolled into CTMX
positions.summary: His 2025 BioPick, up 416% when Novartis bought the company early in the year. May 13: says most of that position rolled into CytomX.

positions.statusNote: Most of the RGLS proceeds rolled into it
positions.summary: May 13: says most of his Regulus position rolled into CytomX.

positions.statusNote: Bought more Feb 3; long calls Apr 29
positions.summary: Feb 3: bought more at the $31 level. Apr 29: says he is long BBIO calls and was shocked by the strong Q1 launch.

positions.statusNote: Bought for the first time Apr 2
positions.summary: Apr 2: just bought IONS for the first time, on what looked like forced selling during the crash.

positions.statusNote: Building a position Mar 4
positions.summary: Mar 4: says he is building a CYTK position and thinks they can turn it around.

positions.statusNote: Says he owns it (Jun 6)
positions.summary: Jun 6: one of the gene therapy companies he says he knows well and owns.

positions.statusNote: Selling it in Apr to buy more NKTR
positions.summary: Apr 9: selling relative outperformers such as FATE to buy more underperformers (NKTR). May 31: says he made a lot of money on it when it was way up.

positions.statusNote: Short earlier in 2025, then several brief longs
positions.summary: Mar 31: says he is exposed long. May 6: not long right now. Jun 24 and Dec 16: counts VKTX among shorts he made money on. Aug 21: most recent position was a brief long trade from the low $20s. Nov 5: bought a VKTX dip. Sep 2026: says he was long for about 30 seconds at some point in 2025.

positions.statusNote: Repeated shorts from June; re-shorted >$11 in Nov
positions.summary: Jun: shorted and covered within 1-2 days. Oct 27: shorted again at a >$1.5B valuation. Nov 5: covered (too early, he says). Nov 6-7: re-entered short above $11 after a patient death. Nov 25: added again.

positions.statusNote: Shorted after hours, covered next day +30%
positions.summary: Shorted after hours on Dec 1 on worse PSA responses; covered Dec 2 with a gain of more than 30% in under 24 hours.

positions.statusNote: He says he 'crushed' an IOVA short in 2025
positions.summary: Apr 27, 2026: lists IOVA with VKTX as shorts he 'crushed last year'. Mar 2025: says his bearishness was tied to setup and valuation. Still publicly bearish on IOVA in Aug-Oct 2026, without saying he is short.

positions.statusNote: Named as his only obesity exposure in spring 2025
positions.summary: Nov 25, 2024: adds SRRK to his list of likely buyout targets. In a reply under his Mar 31, 2025 Viking post (before May 2), he says he owns nothing in obesity 'unless you count SRRK'.

positions.statusNote: Long; named as a buyout target
positions.summary: Nov 4, 2024: likes VRNA and TARS as buyout targets and says he is long both.

positions.statusNote: Long; named as a buyout target
positions.summary: Nov 4, 2024: likes TARS and VRNA as buyout targets and says he is long both.

positions.statusNote: Long at points in 2024; not long by Aug 26
positions.summary: Aug 24, 2024: says he has been long VKTX at certain points that year. Aug 26: not long.

positions.statusNote: Long into CSCC data (he calls it a miss)
positions.summary: In a May 31, 2025 post listing calls he got wrong, he says he was long REPL into its CSCC data.

positions.statusNote: Long for much of 2024 (he calls it a miss)
positions.summary: Same May 31, 2025 post: says he was long ELYM during much of 2024.
